text_block_list.text:
"Mejiro Ryan trains steadily in 
preparation for the Classics. Then, one 
day—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we have a huge problem!! Did you 
see this... "Umamusume NEWS"!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen lost two races in a row?! At this 
rate, even making it to the Classics is in 
jeopardy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The article says... "A complete defeat on 
skill. An uninspired loss that raises 
serious concerns"...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm heading out! To McQueen's side. 
Something might have happened!"
We decided to head over together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ryan and Trainer, is something the 
matter?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen, about your recent races... did 
something happen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Even though it's right before the 
important Classics... How are you feeling? 
Is your body doing okay?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Is that what you came to ask about? If 
so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Whether it is fine or not, you may see 
for yourself firsthand."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Ryan, wouldn't you care to run 
alongside me? Just a light—mile race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh... A mile race?

We ended up running a mock race at the 
mile— that is, 1,600 meters on turf.

I watch over the race as the referee. The 
result was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... You've grown so 
strong, Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I won... Is this the result of my 
training? Or could it be...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Once more... Once more, please. This 
time... at double the distance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Double!? If it's double a mile, that 
means... 1600 × 2... so 3200m?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Understood. —Let's do this!!

The rematch begins. And then, a shocking 
turn of events unfolds.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Haaahh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wait, McQueen!? W-What's with that pace?!

Showing no signs of her earlier fatigue, 
Mejiro McQueen crossed the finish line at 
a speed unfitting for a long-distance 
race.

Faced with such phenomenal stamina, Mejiro 
Ryan's late charge couldn't reach them at 
all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa, *cough*... What was with 
that running style just now? There's no 
way she could keep up that kind of lap 
time...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just as I thought. There doesn't 
seem to be any problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan, you need not worry. I have been in 
top form ever since my debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, there is no need to worry 
when it comes to long-distance running.
choice_data_list:
McQueen, surely not from the very 
beginning...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My true calling is to conquer the GⅠ 
most fitting for the Mejiro family—the 
Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The training menu is specialized 
specifically towards that goal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No matter how important the Classics are, 
chasing two hares and missing the true 
prize defeats the whole purpose, doesn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So McQueen, you've had your eyes fixed 
solely on the Spring Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the values of society are not 
necessarily absolute.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There are dreams so intoxicating that 
you'd pursue them, even if it means 
casting aside immediate glory...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have made up my mind. No matter what 
anyone says, I shall bring back to the 
Mejiro family the heaviest thing I believe 
in.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even so, are you still worried about me, 
Ryan?

Mejiro Ryan said nothing. Without a word, 
she simply stood there, her legs 
trembling. Just like before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, please train me!! Make me 
stronger, please!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...I feel so pathetic. McQueen is walking 
a thorny path toward her own goals, and 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And yet, I haven't been focusing on the 
Classic which was my biggest goal at all! 
All I've been doing is worrying about 
others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can race like this... 
McQueen will pull even further ahead of 
me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So don't hold back, please! So that next 
time we clash, I won't lose!!
choice_data_list: It's gonna be tough, you sure about that?
It's gonna be tough, are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, even if I lose in terms of raw power, 
I don't want to lose when it comes to 
betting on my dreams! That's why...!!

With an anxious look on her face, Mejiro 
Ryan runs desperately.

To make it to the Classic of my dreams. 
And to prepare for my distant future clash 
with Mejiro McQueen.
